summary: Investigated two reported layout issues in the conversation UI: auto-scroll problems while the agent replies, and a large gap below the last agent message before the composer. Read relevant Svelte components (Conversation, MessageList, Composer, App), the follow.ts logic and tests, and inspected @tanstack/virtual-core internals to understand options like scrollPaddingEnd, scrollToEnd, followOnAppend, and anchorTo. Tests pass and svelte-autofixer produced only suggestions (no errors).
